integrity: All claims are supported by a complete elementary proof and finite literal-overlap checker. The checker is a corroborating finite experiment, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns fixed-length binary weight-three cross-bifix-free codes for every n>=4, not larger weights, variable length, or unconstrained codes; unindexed equivalents remain a novelty risk.
title: Exact capacity and rigidity of weight-three binary cross-bifix-free codes
